title: Bridging the Gap: From Innovation to Patient Impact
subtitle: Ethics, Evidence, Regulation and Responsible Medical Device Translation
presenter: Dr Vikas Kumar Jha · KIIT University, Bhubaneswar

paths.core40: 40-minute workshop: the 24 slides flagged core (39.50 min scripted): every vote and decision, the FoGO and SwaKnee evidence, risk classes, the licence matrix, FoGO's path, the quiz, the world map and the India–USA–EU comparison
paths.full: 75-minute seminar: all 54 main slides (70 min scripted), with the full regulatory deep-dive

spine: Two composite patients, Ramesh (Parkinson's, freezing of gait, FoGO) and Kamala (knee osteoarthritis, SwaKnee), followed along six stages: Need → Evidence → People → Permission → Access → Safety. Permission is the deep module: regulation in India by risk class, CDSCO obligations and guidance, then the comparison abroad.

slides.title: India's regulatory architecture
slides.message: One Act, one set of Rules, many actors
slides.visual: Org infographic: D&C Act 1940 → MDR-2017 → CDSCO/DCGI (Central Licensing Authority) and State Licensing Authorities; notified bodies; testing labs; MvPI/IPC; BIS; NPPA; ethics committees; CTRI — cards with who-does-what

slides.title: From a handful of notified devices to all of them
slides.message: Regulation arrived in phases; the last phase closed in 2023
slides.visual: timeline 1940 → 2005 → 2017 → 2018 → Feb/Apr 2020 → Oct 2021 → Oct 2022 → Oct 2023 → 2023 NMDP → 2026 MDSW guidance / proposed amendments

slides.title: Four risk classes decide the route
slides.message: Class A to D by intended use, invasiveness, duration and energy

slides.title: The route to a manufacturing licence
slides.message: QMS, audit or inspection, licence; then keep it
slides.visual: chevronFlow (QMS per Fifth Schedule → application MD-3/MD-7 on the portal → notified-body audit (A/B) or CDSCO inspection (C/D) → licence MD-5/MD-9 → retention) with timelines and fees under each step + statTiles (fees per site/device by class; validity; retention)

slides.title: Importing, registering and relying on foreign approvals
slides.message: Imports are central; some foreign approvals shorten the evidence path
slides.visual: Two panels: import route (MD-14 → MD-15, free sale certificate, authorised agent, fees) and Class A non-sterile non-measuring registration; plus a 'reliance' card for devices approved in listed countries
